# Data acquisition interface API endpoint
{: .no_toc}



## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `dataacquisitioninterface` (detail, create, update), `dataacquisitioninterfaces` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `dataacquisition`, `interface` unique together

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | number **[read-only]** |
| `dataacquisition` | [`dataacquisition`](/api/modules/dataacquisition/) id **[required]** |
| `interface` | [`experimentalinterface`](/api/modules/experimentalinterface/) id **[required]** |
| `interface_name` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `order` | number; nullable |
| `metadata_json` | JSON object; nullable |
| `metadata_schema_version` | string; max 20 characters |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('dataacquisitioninterface', load_all=True)
records = resp['dataacquisitioninterfaces']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('dataacquisitioninterface', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.dataacquisitioninterfaces;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "dataacquisitioninterfaces": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "dataacquisition": "<dataacquisition-id>",
            "interface": "<experimentalinterface-id>",
            "interface_name": null,
            "order": 1,
            "metadata_json": {},
            "metadata_schema_version": "set by the server"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('dataacquisitioninterface', data={"dataacquisition": "<dataacquisition-id>", "interface": "<experimentalinterface-id>"})
record = resp.json()['dataacquisitioninterface']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('dataacquisition', '<dataacquisition-id>', 'interface', '<experimentalinterface-id>'), 'dataacquisitioninterface');
record = created.dataacquisitioninterface;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('dataacquisitioninterface', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['dataacquisitioninterface']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('dataacquisitioninterface', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.dataacquisitioninterface;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "dataacquisitioninterface": {
        "id": 1,
        "dataacquisition": "<dataacquisition-id>",
        "interface": "<experimentalinterface-id>",
        "interface_name": null,
        "order": 1,
        "metadata_json": {},
        "metadata_schema_version": "set by the server"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('dataacquisitioninterface', id='<id>', data={"order": 1})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'order', 1), 'dataacquisitioninterface', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/dataacquisitioninterface/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('dataacquisitioninterface', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'dataacquisitioninterface');
```
